name: A hypothesis that contradicts the published prefix is refused, not clamped
description: docs/protocol.md §8.3 forbids clamping because it hides the defect ICER exists to measure — and in this direction it would additionally mean shipping a message whose bytes below the published mark have changed, which is the failure that corrupts the user's document. This is the signature of a batch model that re-decodes rather than extends: diverge_offset 0 means it revised the first word.
